determinism: This manifest contains no wall-clock field. All timestamps derive from the committed pin, so re-running the ingester against the same pin reproduces this file byte for byte. Run time is recorded in reports/ingest.md.
integrity: Every entry with kind='file' carries a sha256 that is the actual SHA-256 of that one file; `python -m ingest.verify_digests` recomputes them from disk. A digest is never padded, widened, or synthesised to fit a field.
